name: assets_count_entry
description: REQ-817 / GH #4374 (asset count K2, D-128). One entry of the append-only log of an asset count order: who typed which input on which sheet line and when, with the value before and after. entry_no is 1..n per order. No function of module assets updates or deletes an entry. method is typed or scan (REQ-818 / GH #4373, K3: a scan entry has scanned_text, scan_outcome and, for a location, location_id; a location scan has no line_no). count_order_id is a real foreign key onto assets_count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column.
